summary: Heading into the last half hour the benchmarks are holding modest gains near the day's better levels, with value buying in large caps keeping the Nifty above 23,100 and IT still the drag.

detail.leaders: Axis Bank, Asian Paints, HCLTech; realty; private banks
detail.laggards: Nifty IT (weakest sector); small finance banks
detail.tone: Steady since 14:30: the afternoon recovery has held, with the Nifty above 23,100 after the 2 pm reading of 23,087.45 (+0.11%). There has been no fresh selling into the close so far, a calmer end than Thursday's rout.
watch: A close above Thursday's 23,063 would snap the losing streak
FII provisional flow data after the close

top.title: US 10-yr hovers near 5.1% after 5.15% peak

more: The 10-yr topped 5.15% before retreating to about 5.1%

top.title: US PCE on Sept 30 is next yield test
